name: MTDDH paediatric pelvic X-rays with hip dysplasia key points (Qi et al., Science Data Bank 2025)
what: 2,156 pelvic radiographs of children from the Children's Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine and Hebei Children's Hospital in two parts: 1,250 annotated with four regions for image quality and eight key points for developmental dysplasia of the hip, and 906 with the eight key points (Science Data Bank doi:10.57760/sciencedb.24372, V1, issued 2025-04-29, 4.05 GB in three files); the lumbosacral junction is in the field of a pelvic film, as in the Mendeley DDH hip sets
licence: CC BY 4.0 (DataCite's record of the DOI, read 2026-10-23)
how_to_get: The owner opens https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.24372 (https://www.scidb.cn/detail?dataSetId=c088644bd0b2406eb49830ad447c17fb), reads whether a login is needed and reads the file list.
A Science Data Bank route is written for tools/acquisition_fetch.py before any job, as for scidb_enhance_pet_1_6k.

Fetch as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py http-get --url U --dest FILE, U being the address the page gives, onto /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/scidb_mtddh/raw by grid/README.md.
